verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly addresses training. Ultrametric says it "runs no model" and that work uses the user's own AI plan. The `--path` local project context "stays local during retrieval," and local record stores work without the hosted service, which limits what reaches Ultrametric. However, company records, runs and progress are hosted, and nothing states how that hosted data may or may not be used for AI training. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training data-use policy, an opt-out control or setting, and coverage of whether the hosted company records are excluded from training (including by any third parties), plus independent corroboration. [2026-10-08 adversarial bias audit (owner-product bring-up lane): reverted partial 3 -> none 0 — the rationale concedes the evidence only indirectly addresses training and that nothing states how hosted records may be used; "runs no model" is an architecture statement, not a no-training commitment. Every peer sits at none/na on the same class of silence. Ultrametric-affiliation governance, README §9.]
